record.question: Miss World 2013 Ms. Megan Young belongs to
record.explanation: Answer C: Philipines. Megan Young represented the Philippines when she won Miss World 2013. The organizer's original 28 September 2013 announcement identifies her country. The printed Philipines is a spelling defect, not a different country. Historical/source note: Source option C misspells Philippines as Philipines; retain the printed form in source data. Reference: https://www.missworld.com/news/megan-young-philippines-is-miss-world-2013. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
